meta.description: Grows the young fruit body from a knot of hyphae. Every tip follows the same rules, the schedules change them over the simulation and make the shape.

iterations.description: How many times every tip grows one segment

initial_tips.description: Tips in the knot the fruit body starts from

segment_length.description: How far a tip grows per iteration. The fields are measured in segment lengths, so this scales the whole primordium.

persistence.description: How much a tip keeps its old direction against the fields

branch_probability.description: Chance per iteration that a tip branches, where the density allows it

density_threshold.description: Tips only branch where the hyphae around them are less dense than this

secondary_factor.description: Old branch points branch again where the density is below the threshold times this

leading_share.description: Share of new branches that are leading hyphae, which ignore their neighbours' direction and start new strands

gravitropic_angle.description: Preferred angle of the tips to the vertical over the simulation, bottom is up, the middle sideways, top is down

autotropism.description: How strongly tips are pulled towards the mass of the colony over the simulation

galvanotropism.description: How strongly tips turn parallel to their neighbours over the simulation, which joins them into strands

waist_height.description: Hyphae growing up below this height become stipe, above it cap

max_segments.description: Growth stops at this many segments
